final.memo:
Our investment in the Company continues to perform in accordance with our primary underwriting criteria. Since reinitiating our position, the business has successfully integrated its trilateral rail network, achieving over $800 million in run-rate revenue synergies that exceed our initial expectations [D04, D08]. The company’s ability to generate 11% EPS growth in a difficult 2024 freight environment underscores the strength of its oligopolistic franchise and the efficacy of its management team [D04, D09].

While the current trade policy environment presents an extrinsic risk that warrants close monitoring, we believe the structural necessity of the network for North American commerce provides a durable defensive moat [D06, D09]. Management’s guidance of 12–18% adjusted EPS growth for 2025 reflects confidence in the resilience of integrated supply chains despite tariff headlines [D04, D08]. The company remains a high-quality, free-cash-flow-generative business that is well-positioned to compound value over the long term [D09].

We remain disciplined regarding the company’s capital requirements and debt levels, which remain substantial but manageable given the strong operating cash flow [D02, D06]. At a forward multiple of roughly 21-23x projected earnings, the stock continues to offer an attractive rate of return consistent with our standards for quality compounders [D05, D10]. We maintain our position with high conviction as the fundamental thesis remains firmly on track [D09].
